# KaTeX 0.19.0

Local distribution of [KaTeX](https://katex.org/), the MIT-licensed math renderer.
The JavaScript, CSS, and fonts are copied without modification from the
`katex@0.19.0` npm package. Its copyright and license are retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

To refresh this copy after changing the pinned dependency, run
`node scripts/vendor-math.mjs`.
